projects.title: KioskDrop Enterprise — Smart-Locker ITAM, FinOps & Mobile Platform
projects.tech: Next.js 14, React Native (Expo SDK 58), TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, SQLite WAL, SSE, Vitest, Jest, Docker
bullets: Eliminated race-condition locker double-bookings by engineering conditional atomic Prisma reservations (updateMany with count === 1 check), verified under a 20-worker parallel concurrency test.

Prevented PIN timing side-channels and BadUSB intrusions by implementing salted HMAC-SHA256 verification (crypto.timingSafeEqual), 5-attempt lockout (HTTP 423), foreign VID/PID quarantine (HTTP 409), and a SHA-256 hash-chained custody ledger.

Achieved zero IEEE-754 float drift on statutory tax compliance by building an integer-paise Indian Customs Duty Engine (44.40% BCD/SWS/IGST) alongside RBAC Zaggle/Happay FinOps and SAP/Oracle/Zoho ERP adapters.

Synchronized 12-bay hardware telemetry across Next.js 14 web dashboards and an Expo Android client (Bearer JWT in SecureStore + react-native-sse), backed by 39/39 Vitest backend tests and 24/24 Jest mobile tests.

projects.title: MiniLedger — Fintech Peer-to-Peer Loan Ledger & Mobile App
projects.tech: Node.js 20, Express, TypeScript, PostgreSQL 16, Prisma ORM, Expo (React Native), TanStack Query, Zod, Jest, Supertest
bullets: Prevented floating-point rounding drift and timezone overdue bugs by storing balances in integer minor units (amountMinor), aggregating sums in SQL, and enforcing date-only PostgreSQL (@db.Date) columns.
Eliminated duplicate loan repayments by implementing an atomic conditional updateMany state transition returning 409 Conflict (ALREADY_REPAID) and distinguishing ownership errors (404 Not Found).

Secured mobile authentication and receipt attachments by building HMAC-SHA256 rate-limited OTP + JWT auth (expo-secure-store) and UUID-sanitized Multer image uploads verified via an isolated Jest + Supertest suite.

projects.title: Remote Trackpad Web — Turn Smartphone Browser into PC Mouse
